scope.name: Local 3D coin visual and motion upgrade
limitations: No production deployment, provider configuration or Supabase writes.
Local Chrome/WebKit and synthetic visibility/context-loss tests do not prove physical Safari, Android, safe areas, real zoom, battery cost or native shell behavior.
Audio checks observe sound creation and mute routing, not physical audible quality.
Photo texture/bump detail is not a sculpted portrait scan.
